posts.text: Anlon does what it does in ARFF vehicles with Rosenbauer , from what I understand they are the sole distributors for Rosenbauer in India and also the ones handling maintenance and refurbishment of these vehicles in India , and now wants to expand to countries in and around India too . I fail to understand how will they “manufacture/assemble” these ARFF vehicles in India given that these are so complex vehicles , and it is not something like a Rubber removal machine wherein you import the main equipment from Europe and fit them on a locally sourced BharatBenz chassis .
